senses.gloss: m. (שבר; cmp. מִקְוֶה) collection of water, pond; cavity for reception of water, opp. מַדְרוֹן slope.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 42a:6">Pes. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>מקום א׳</he> place where water poured out would remain stagnant.
